selection_rationale: The selection prioritizes papers that directly address the definition, taxonomy, evaluation, detection, and mitigation of hallucinations in LLMs. It includes foundational surveys for context, specific benchmarks for evaluation, and methodological papers for detection and mitigation. Duplicate entries and overly broad surveys were removed to ensure a high-quality, focused set of references.
anticipated_gaps: Specific empirical studies on hallucination in code generation or software engineering.
Longitudinal studies tracking hallucination rates as models scale or are updated.
Detailed analysis of hallucination in low-resource languages or under-resourced domains.
Quantitative comparison of the effectiveness of different hallucination mitigation strategies across diverse benchmarks.
Investigation into the root causes of hallucination at the token/prediction level (beyond general taxonomy).
